samples.rationale: Grouping and ordering live in an immutable record (`SpecialtyDirectory.of`, `List.copyOf` in both canonical constructors) rather than the controller, which only delegates and selects a view — catalog-conformant naming and layering; `holderNames()` puts display formatting in the domain type and `held.getId().equals(...)` risks NPE on unsaved entities. Tests use BDD names, shared factories (`SpecialtyTestData.createVet`), and hand-written in-memory repositories instead of a mock framework, but carry mystery literals that drive outcomes (`createVet(4, "Rita", "Carter", surgery)`, bare ids), assert template internals (`"none"`, `not(containsString("fa-step-forward"))`), and `theExistingPagesShouldCarryNoLinkToTheSpecialtyDirectory` walks `src/main/resources/templates` with loops and try/catch inside a `@WebMvcTest`. PRD requirement, edge cases, open questions, contracts table, and all locale bundles are current.

Grouping and ordering live in the immutable `SpecialtyDirectory` record (List.copyOf in both canonical constructors), leaving `SpecialtyController.showSpecialtyDirectory` as pure bind-delegate-select, so no new rule lands in a controller; naming matches the catalog. Minor friction: `Listing.holderNames()` builds display strings inside the domain value object, which the Type formatter/view layer owns, and a repository is added for a lookup entity reachable via Vet. Tests use hand-written in-memory repositories, shared factories (`createVet`, `createSpecialty`) and BDD names, and push the new rule into unit tests. Deductions: bare ids and `"James", "Carter"` literals, markup-coupled assertions (`"none"`, `"fa-step-forward"`), and `theExistingPagesShouldCarryNoLinkToTheSpecialtyDirectory` walking a hard-coded relative template path with try/catch logic. PRD requirement, edge cases, open questions, contracts table and a Scale and Load row all move together.

Grouping and ordering live in the immutable `SpecialtyDirectory` record (List.copyOf in both canonical constructors), leaving `SpecialtyController.showSpecialtyDirectory` to bind nothing and select a view — correct layering, catalog-conforming names, no business rule added to the controller. Two mild frictions: `SpecialtyRepository` is a gateway for a lookup child of the Vet aggregate rather than a root, and `Listing.holderNames()` puts display formatting (`getFirstName() + " " + getLastName()`) in the domain value where a formatter belongs. Tests are BDD-named, construct through `SpecialtyTestData` factories, and use a hand-written in-memory repository rather than a mock framework; but bare literals persist (`createVet(1, "James", "Carter")`, `"fa-step-forward"`, `"none"`), the template-walking test with try/catch sits oddly in a `@WebMvcTest` class, and the integration test asserts two concerns. PRD REQ-VET-003, contracts table, and a Scale and Load row leave no visible stale claim.
